note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 30B(1, 2), MEX 19-21, 25, REG 15; A06b Const 30B(1, 2), MEX 19-21, 25, REG 15; L05 Const 37B(1)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Mexico, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Mexico for 5 years immediately prior to the application. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country (only after citizenship has been granted). ... Person is a citizen by naturalisation and voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country.
